post.description: OpenGraph/Twitter/oEmbed preview, cached 7 days. Failures answer 200 with just {url, finalUrl}.

Query grammar: terms are AND-ed with prefix matching, "quoted phrase" is a phrase, -term excludes,
title:foo restricts to titles. Titles, aliases, block text and (includeFiles) extracted file text are
searched in both the russian and english configurations; results are collapsed to one hit per node.

get.description: Link + parent edges for the workspace (capped at 2000 nodes; truncated=true when capped).

delete.description: Owner only; refuses to delete the caller's personal workspace (400).

get.description: Children of parentId (roots when omitted). Archived nodes are hidden unless includeArchived=true; trashed nodes are never listed. Requires the X-Workspace-Id header.

post.description: Deep-copies the subtree (title of the root gets " (copy)"), including page content via the collab service. A `Warning: 199` header is set when content could not be copied.
multipart/form-data: file, nodeId (required), blockId?, propertyId?, purpose? (content|icon|cover). 413 when NOOK_MAX_UPLOAD_MB is exceeded.
Server-side fetch (SSRF-guarded: public http(s) hosts only, 10 s header timeout, upload size limit).

get.description: Bytes with Range support (206), ETag = sha256, Cache-Control: private, max-age=31536000. Inline unless ?download=1. SVG/HTML are served as application/octet-stream unless downloaded.

delete.description: Deletes the attachment row; the blob is removed by the daily blob-gc job once unreferenced for 24 h.

get.description: image/webp derivative; w ∈ {160, 320, 640, 1280, 1920} (default 640). 404 for non-images, 503 when libvips is unavailable.
Trashed subtree roots, newest first. `q` filters by title (ci substring), `limit` defaults to 50 (max 200).

delete.description: Permanently deletes everything in the trash the caller may edit.

post.description: Restores the subtree. Target = parentId ?? original parent if alive ?? workspace root.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the trashed subtree (nodes, documents, updates, blocks, links, snapshots, attachment rows).

get.description: The caller's favorites in this workspace, ordered by position (fractional index).

put.description: Idempotent. `position` omitted = append (or keep the current position when already a favorite).

get.description: Newest first; trashed nodes excluded. `limit` defaults to 20 (max 100).

post.description: Records a visit; the server keeps the last 100 per user and workspace.

get.description: Title + alias lookup: exact > prefix > trigram similarity (pg_trgm, threshold 0.2). Trashed excluded, archived last. Empty `q` = most recently updated pages. `kinds` = comma-separated NodeKind list.

put.description: Owner writes. `trash.retentionDays` (integer 1..3650, default 30) drives the hourly `trash-purge` job.

get.description: Links pointing at this page, including unresolved [[wikilinks]] that match its title or aliases.
Union of manual and inline (#hashtag) tags; each entry carries its source.

put.description: Replaces the manual tag set; inline tags collected from the document text are untouched.
Replaces all page properties. Values are validated by type (dates must be ISO-8601).

patch.description: Merges the given properties; a null value removes that property.

put.description: Aliases are unique (case-insensitive) per workspace; 409 carries the conflicting node id.

post.description: Manual "Save version": snapshots the current block projection.
Snapshots the current state as kind "pre-restore", then replaces the live document with the chosen version.

get.description: Current block projection rebuilt as a tree (read-only rendering, embeds, previews).

post.description: Streams a zip: <Title>.md next to a folder <Title>/ for children, frontmatter, relative internal links.
Imports .md/.markdown/.txt/.html/.csv/.zip. Archives over 20 MB return 202 { jobId }; poll GET /import/{jobId}.
